# Relationships and explanations

Implemented templates include `flowchart`, `org-chart`, `architecture`, `network` and `sports-lineup`. Supply explicit nodes, labels, relationships and any relevant grouping/positions in the selected schema. Diagram rendering never discovers entities or infers unseen relationships. Charts also support graph/hierarchy data for appropriate visual forms; discover the exact template first.

Use diagrams when structure explains the subject more clearly than prose. Source descriptions and example data remain distinguishable from verified facts. [Template index](README.md).
